response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count::FLOAT) AS avg_telescope_count FROM station_stats) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth, s.telescope_count, s.telescope_count / o.avg_telescope_count AS ratio FROM station_stats s CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
